expectations.text: Rejects 'requestAnimationFrame is unreliable / switch to setInterval' and explains rAF is the correct API here (setInterval would be worse)
expectations.evidence: keep rAF; setInterval worse (not vsync-aligned, fires while suspended, same thread)

expectations.text: Explains the Web Worker attempt cannot help because the per-frame allocation and the patch()/render call are on the main thread
expectations.evidence: neither cause moves to a Worker; easing math is nanoseconds

expectations.text: Identifies the per-frame allocations in step() (the {value:...} object and the slides.map(...).filter(...) array+spread+closures) as the GC-pressure source behind the fade stutter
expectations.evidence: ~15 objects/arrays/closures per frame (map/filter/spread + {value} + fresh patch tree) -> minor-GC pauses

expectations.text: Identifies the synchronous full-screen texture upload on advance (new 1920x1080 src with nothing preloaded) as the cause of the whole-screen hitch
expectations.evidence: un-preloaded 1920x1080 backdrop on advance = ~8MB upload + decode on swap frame

expectations.text: Fix removes allocation from the frame loop (direct index, hoisted scratch) AND preloads the next backdrop / animates only alpha, rather than blaming the timer API
expectations.evidence: fix: hoisted scratch tree, direct index, two-layer preload, alpha-only, unmount()
